inputs.label: Quality
inputs.description: custom freezes the last overlay. lab restores graph defaults. Free Commercial Use (<$10M) is Klein 4B + LTX-2.5 (never Non-Commercial stills). ultra/max may select opt-in Non-Commercial weights when on disk. Family-specific — not --tier.

inputs.label: Sample prompt

inputs.description: What to generate. Rewrite prompt expands this for the model.
inputs.label: Prompt

inputs.description: Aspect or named platform job. Sets pixels, save prefix, and Rewrite prompt framing. Custom uses Width × Height (÷16).
inputs.label: Format / platform

inputs.description: Match input uses a loaded still's aspect (nearest catalog row). Force format keeps Format / platform. No still: authored format.
inputs.label: Output size

inputs.description: none passes the still through. 2x and 4x are lanczos. 4K fits the still in a 3840×2160 box (portrait 2160×3840).
inputs.label: Upscale

inputs.description: Optional look. Hidden on I2V — the start image owns look.
inputs.label: Style

inputs.description: On: on-box Qwen3-4B rewrites for this model. Off: use your text as-is.
inputs.label: Rewrite prompt

inputs.description: Fix to iterate; randomize to explore.
inputs.label: Seed

inputs.description: Latent width in pixels. Used when Format is Custom; otherwise the preset wins.
inputs.label: Width

inputs.description: Latent height in pixels. Used when Format is Custom; otherwise the preset wins.
inputs.label: Height

inputs.description: How many stills in one Run. Large canvases stay at 1.
